product_one_liner.value: RedTeam provides construction management software for commercial general contractors to manage bids, budgets, field work, documents and project financials from preconstruction through closeout.

employee_band.notes: Based on the reported employee count of 98; the profile also displays an inconsistent company-size label.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog presents construction-industry education and product marketing, rather than engineering-authored implementation posts.

public_docs.notes: Public help center with collections for RedTeam Go, RedTeam Flex, Fieldlens and TeamPlayer.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers site exists and a Revenue Operations Manager posting is readable, but the complete job board could not be read. No qualifying live AI/ML/data-science posting was verified; an absence cannot be established.

model_provider.notes: No named model or provider was found in the reviewed AI-product announcement, product blog/help materials, privacy policy or user terms; no public named AI-subprocessor list was located.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed legal/privacy pages name none of the five requested certifications; this does not establish that the company lacks certifications.

last_funding.notes: February 2022 is the reported round month; the Form D was filed February 2 and reports first sale on January 19, 2022.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest publicly recorded round is February 2022, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers site exists but its complete job board could not be read. Historical SDR/AE recruiting posts and a recent third-party SMB Account Executive listing were found, but no current official application posting for those roles was verified.

launched_6mo.notes: August 19, 2026: announced the new RedTeam Flex submittals experience, including specification-book extraction, standardized review workflows and next-action ownership tracking.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: July 9, 2026: announced Connor Schone joining as Vice President of Finance.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Revenue Operations Manager posting explicitly describes administering HubSpot and Gainsight and synchronizing data with the GTM stack, including PandaDoc.
